factors.name: Test presence and feedback speed
factors.description: An agent can only verify its changes when tests exist and run in reasonable time.

factors.name: Type strictness
factors.description: Static types or equivalent checks catch wrong changes before they run.

factors.name: Direct API calls
factors.description: What a call does is visible at the call site, not hidden behind reflection, magic or dynamic dispatch.

factors.name: File size and context legibility
factors.description: Files and the context needed to change them fit in an agent's working context.

factors.name: Module boundary clarity
factors.description: Modules have clear edges, so a change can be scoped to one area.

factors.name: Documented intent
factors.description: Non-standard practices and project-specific rules are written down.

factors.name: Observability
factors.description: Logs, errors and metrics show what the code does when it runs.

factors.name: Dev and deploy simplicity
factors.description: The project builds and runs locally with documented, scriptable steps.

factors.name: Dependency and runtime currency
factors.description: Dependencies and runtimes are supported versions, not end-of-life.
